scope: Finite combinatorial verification only; not a proof of infinitary computability statements.

tests.name: pairing_and_blocks
tests.scope: Pairing inverse for x < 32768 and 14 x 129 coordinate pairs; blocks k < 14.

tests.name: column_and_tail_counts
tests.scope: Every prefix length 0..4096, columns 0..13, and tails 0..14.

tests.name: exhaustive_majority_error
tests.scope: All binary words of lengths 1,2,4,8,16 and both constant targets.

tests.name: normalizer_and_roundtrip
tests.scope: Rows 0..11, bits 0..11 for exact roundtrip; idempotence on 8 x 8 blocks of a sample oracle.

tests.name: finite_masks_tail_bound_and_modulus
tests.scope: 160 seeded finite mask arrays, 9 cutoffs, finite prefix samples and modulus samples; integer arithmetic only.

tests.name: finite_no_cross_disagreement
tests.scope: All pairs of three-entry possible-output lists with entries undefined,0,1 (729 rectangles).

tests.name: interleaved_rows
tests.scope: 12 even and odd rows; 10 decoded bits each; toy convergent odd-row approximations.
